web_search: Search the web for current information, news, weather, or any topic | search for latest AI news | what is the weather in Tokyo | find information about python decorators | who won the super bowl
web_fetch: Fetch and read the content of a web page or URL | open https://example.com | read the page at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python
note_save: Save a task or project note with a title and body (auto-timestamped) | save a note about project ideas | take a note: meeting at 3pm | note down the api endpoints
note_read: Read a note by title (exact or partial match) | show me my note about project ideas | what did I write about python tips | read my note about weekend plans
note_list: List all saved notes with timestamps | list my notes | what notes do I have | show all notes
note_search: Search notes by keyword in title or content | find notes about python | search my notes for wifi password | search for meeting
file_read: Read the contents of any text file | read config.py | show me the contents of main.py | open requirements.txt
file_write: Create or overwrite a file with content | create a file called hello.py with print('hello') | save this code to script.py
file_list: List files and folders in a directory (defaults to current folder) | what files are here | list the current folder | what is in the tools directory
datetime_info: Get current date and time for any timezone | what time in Tokyo | current time in London | what's the date in New York | time in Asia/Shanghai

youtube_play: Search YouTube and play the best matching music or video. Use when user says play/search/find a song, music, artist, or video | play despacito | play some lofi beats | play taylor swift anti-hero | play classical music for studying | play the weeknd | search for a song | find me some music | play a video

playlist: Manage your saved music playlist: list, search, remove, favorite/unfavorite songs, play/pause/shuffle saved tracks, show top played, clear all. Actions: list, top, favorite, unfavorite, play, stop, remove, clear, search, shuffle | list my playlist | show my songs | list my saved music | show my playlist | list my saved songs | favorite despacito | play my favorite song | show my top songs | stop the music | remove despacito from playlist | delete song 3 from my playlist | clear my playlist | search saved songs for taylor | shuffle my music | play something random

imagine: Generate an image from a text prompt using NVIDIA NIM. Supports SDXL and Playground v2.5. Saves to storage/images/ and returns the file path | generate an image of a cyberpunk cat | imagine a mountain landscape at sunset digital art | create a logo for my startup a blue geometric fox | draw a pixel art spaceship

images: Browse, search, and manage previously generated images in storage/images/. Actions: list, search <name>, remove <name/number>, view <name/number> | show my generated images | list saved images | find images about cyberpunk | delete image 3 | remove the mountain landscape image | show me the pixel art spaceship image

hackernews: Browse Hacker News: top/new/best/ask/show stories, view comments, search posts, look up users. Actions: top, new, best, ask, show, comments <story_id>, user <username>, search <query> | show top HN stories | what's new on hacker news | show me Ask HN posts | search hacker news for rust | get comments for story 432423 | show hn user whoishiring

reddit: Browse Reddit: front page, subreddit hot/new/top posts, search, get comments, view user profiles. Actions: front, hot, new, top, comments, search, user | show reddit front page | hot posts from r/python | top posts from r/wallstreetbets this week | search reddit for AI news | comments from r/AskReddit for post abc123 | show reddit user spez
